description: This PHP class 'CookieJar' manages a collection of HTTP cookies, including creation, retrieval, filtering, filtering, and serialization of cookies, as well as handling cookie persistence and storage. It implements cookie management logic for HTTP client interactions, particularly for Guzzle HTTP client.

classes.name: CookieJar
classes.description: A class that stores and manages a collection of cookies, providing mechanisms to add, retrieve, filter, remove, and serialize cookies, as well as to generate cookie headers for HTTP requests.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new CookieJar instance, optionally with a strict mode flag and an array of SetCookie objects or configurations.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates a CookieJar from an associative array of cookies and a domain, generating corresponding SetCookie objects.

methods.name: shouldPersist
methods.description: Determines whether a cookie should be persisted based on its expiration, discard flag, and session cookie allowance.

methods.name: getCookieByName
methods.description: Retrieves a cookie by its name, returning the SetCookie object or null if not found.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array representation of all cookies stored in the jar.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes cookies matching the specified domain, path, and name criteria.

methods.name: clearSessionCookies
methods.description: Removes all session cookies (those marked to be discarded).

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a SetCookie object to the jar after validation and conflict resolution.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of cookies stored.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the current cookies.

methods.name: extractCookies
methods.description: Extracts cookies from an HTTP response and adds them to the jar if they match criteria.

methods.name: getCookiePathFromRequest
methods.description: Computes the default path for a cookie based on the request URI, following RFC 6265.

methods.name: withCookieHeader
methods.description: Generates a new request with the 'Cookie' header containing valid cookies for the request URI.

methods.name: removeCookieIfEmpty
methods.description: Removes a cookie if its value is null or empty, based on cookie attributes.
